reason: I'm not sending 33,000 dinars up front on Zain Cash to a name I've never heard of and then waiting three weeks hoping it shows up. And 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is almost as much as the shoes, so I can probably find something close in Shorja or on an Instagram page for less.
objection: Paying in advance to a new company with no reviews, no one I know who used it, and a three-week wait where my money is just gone.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or relative telling me they got their order from them, or letting me pay everything on delivery for my first order.
